ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Terminal Biomes
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
TERMINALBIOMES_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-21, §7 Q1: four biomes, one mod, four independent toggles). Four terminal water biomes, fully generalized: none names another franchise or campaign, and each plays standalone on any generated RimWorld planet.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
1. The Scald — a perched, boiling crater lake. Ships its own boiling-lift water terrains and cool bathing margin, a standing-steam sky condition with rare "still days," a steam-catch condenser keyed to natural vents, wandering steam devils, drifting sail/walker set-pieces, and salvageable wrecks in the burning shallows. Its own fishing table (the margin harvest) ships with it. 2. The Propane Lake — a black mirror of liquid fuel ringed by a frozen crust, carrying its own catch table and two RimMandrake-authored terrains (no donor dependency). 3. The Twilight Sea — a hypersaline terminal sea, moldy shore to shore, with a real fishing table (the under-roof shoal economy). 4. The Grey Sea — hypersaline, salt-encrusted, shrinking, with its own fishing table.
Each of the four biomes toggles off independently in Mod Settings, on by default. A frozen `RUT_` twin of each biome def carries a separate, older campaign's world until that world's own planet is repainted — this mod's own defs are what any OTHER planet's generation actually uses.
NOT in this mod (scoped out by the calling item, not deferred sub rosa): new wildAnimals/fishTypes rosters for the Propane Lake / Twilight Sea / Grey Sea beyond what already existed on their donor defs — whether `wildAnimals` even spawns on an impassable water biome is an untested engine question, and the terminal-seas cast has not had its owner sitting yet. The Star Wars creatures that DO ride these biomes (the sando lineage, the lanternwhale, the reefback, the faa/mee pair) ship as a separate Utinni-tier patch onto this mod's own BiomeDefs, gated on the Star Wars bestiary mod — this mod itself names no franchise.
Live proof is OWED at publish time — Windows-Desktop only; see the item's own verify record.
